adminTeam.title: Team.
adminTeam.lead: Closers with access to the CRM. Each one sees only their own portfolio; you see everything.

pending.title: The team list arrives with the data connection
pending.text: The screen is already drawn (preview at /dev/admin/equipo/admin); reading the team and saving invitations is still to come.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.caption: Pending invitations
invitations.emptyText: The ones you send show up here until the person signs in.

invite.title: Invite to the team
invite.roleCloserHint: sees and works their own portfolio
invite.rateHelp: Percentage of what is collected on each project; usually 10 %. It is frozen into each commission when it is created.
invite.totpNote: The invitation email says that the first login asks to set up an authenticator (TOTP).

rate.title: {name}'s rate
rate.help: It only affects new closings. Commissions already created keep their %.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {target}
deactivate.summary: They stop getting into the CRM right away. Their {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}} stay in their name until you reassign them. Their pending commissions do not change.

activate.title: Activate {target}
activate.summary: {target} gets back into the CRM with their portfolio and their rate.

resend.title: Resend invitation
resend.summary: A new link is sent to {target}; the previous one stops working and the new one expires after 14 days.

revoke.title: Cancel invitation
revoke.summary: The link sent to {target} stops working.
